entities.summary: Nevada de Santa Marta, a notable figure in the history of Colombia, associated with Pre-Columbian Civilizations: Muisca, San Agustín, and Beyond (200 BCE–1500). Preceded by Tairona, Zenú, and Other Pre-Columbian Cultures and San Agustín and Tierradentro: Monumental Archaeology. Their legacy influenced El Dorado legend originates from Muisca gold ceremony at Lake Guatavita and Muisca Confederation and the Legend of El Dorado.
